definition: to have the ability to do something
description: On an outdoor sports court with high green walls, a fence and old stone arches, a young woman with a long braid, in a rust sports top, films herself up close, grinning widely, and then points her thumb back over her shoulder. Behind her a young woman in a black sports top and grey shorts holds a huge rough boulder on her shoulder with both hands, straining under its weight. Wooden benches with towels stand under the arches, and a straw mat lies on the ground.

en.question: What is the woman in black carrying?
